boards.title: Boards
boards.description: Workday boards as workday:<slug> or pasted URLs (<tenant>.<wdN>.myworkdayjobs.com/<site>). This Actor accepts only Workday boards; other platforms are returned as one error row each.

postedAfter.title: Posted after
postedAfter.description: Keep only jobs published after this point: an ISO date (2026-11-01) or a relative window (24h, 7d). Applied before billing. Jobs without a publish date are excluded when set (Workday gives day precision only; its "30+ days ago" postings have no date).

titleIncludes.title: Title includes (any)
titleIncludes.description: Keep only jobs whose title contains at least one of these terms (case-insensitive substring). Applied before billing.

titleExcludes.title: Title excludes
titleExcludes.description: Drop jobs whose title contains any of these terms (case-insensitive substring). Applied before billing.
